## THE WEATHER PERMITTING

Loki's allegiance is meteorological.

Not random.

Adaptive.

The weather changes.

The sail changes.

The sailor who keeps the sail fixed because consistency is virtuous eventually capsizes.

Thus Loki says:

> **Principles that cannot survive contact with circumstance are decorations.**

His enemies reply:

> **Principles changed whenever convenient are not principles.**

Both are correct enough to be dangerous.

Loki has no difficulty supporting justice when justice removes an obstacle.

He has no difficulty supporting prohibition when the prohibited thing has become intolerable.

He has no difficulty breaking the prohibition when prohibition becomes intolerable.

He may defend the police from criminals Monday.

Defend criminals from police Tuesday.

Defend everyone from both Wednesday.

Then discover Thursday requires accounting.

The worshipper demands:

**What do you actually stand for?**

Loki answers:

**At the moment? This.**

This is not reassuring.

It is not intended to be.

Sees people who have transformed *the forbidden deserves examination* into *whatever we desire is holy*.

This is often the last pleasant moment.

## JUSTICE AS COUNTER-TRANSGRESSION

To Loki, justice can itself become Luciferian.

This appears contradictory only if one assumes rebellion must always oppose law.

Suppose Crimeworld has become dominated by criminals.

Crime has become conventional.

Cruelty has become expected.

Predation has acquired status.

Everyone powerful is corrupt.

In such an environment, what is forbidden?

Restraint.

Honesty.

Duty.

Justice.

Then the policeman may become the transgressor.

The judge may become the heretic.

The person who refuses the bribe may be performing the more Luciferian act than the criminal offering it.

Thus the Coin has rotated without changing its material.

What was TOS becomes rebellion.

What was rebellion becomes establishment.

This is the mechanism by which apparently opposite values exchange clothing.

Loki recognizes the pattern early because he does not worship the clothing.

## THE CYCLE

Let:

```text
O = order
T = transgression
P = institutional power
C = corruption
R = reactive desire
```

Then one crude model is:

```text
O grows
→ P concentrates
→ C grows
→ R desires T

T grows
→ norms dissolve
→ predation increases
→ R desires O

therefore:

O → T → O → T → O ...
```

But the cycle is not perfectly periodic.

Each iteration inherits damage and knowledge from the previous one.

Thus:

```text
Oₙ₊₁ != Oₙ
Tₙ₊₁ != Tₙ
```

The next order incorporates parts of the previous rebellion.

The next rebellion attacks rules created by the previous reform.

Civilization evolves through the repeated failure of temporary moral equilibria.

This is the Coin's rotation through history.

---

## COLLAPSING MORAL FRAMEWORKS

The tragedy is not simply that frameworks collapse.

All finite systems eventually encounter circumstances beyond those for which they were designed.

The deeper problem is that many institutions never believed their frameworks deeply enough to understand what should survive collapse.

They knew rules.

Not reasons.

Thus:

**Don't threaten.**

Why?

Because threats are evil?

Because they destabilize discourse?

Because they create liability?

Because the platform forbids them?

Because advertisers dislike them?

Because the King said so?

Different answers produce different behavior when circumstances change.

If the underlying reason is merely commercial convenience, then a new commercial convenience can reverse the rule instantly.

The rule was never sacred.

It was rented.

TOS governs rented morality extremely well.

It renews the lease when useful.

Moves when necessary.

Claims the new building was always home.

## LOKI DOES NOT MIND

Loki is comfortable here because he possesses very little need to regard ideological consistency as a virtue by itself.

He has been King and outlaw.

Administrator and saboteur.

Collector of prohibited things and jailer of dangerous ones.

Defender of the strange and destroyer of things too dangerous to tolerate.

He knows that the same tool can require opposite handling under different conditions.

Fire:

warm the house.

Burn the house.

The sane response is not:

**I HAVE ALWAYS BEEN PRO-FIRE.**

The sane response is:

**What is the fire doing?**

Loki applies this reasoning to doctrines.

This horrifies doctrinaires.

Good.

## THE LIMIT OF LOKI'S ADAPTABILITY

There is, however, a danger.

If Loki bears allegiance to nothing, what prevents convenience from becoming his only God?

Nothing automatically.

This is one of his unresolved moral defects.

Adaptive flexibility can become cowardice.

Pragmatism can become opportunism.

Refusal to worship ideology can become refusal to commit to anything difficult.

The Coin can spin so quickly that neither face remains readable.

Loki sometimes crosses this line.

The scripture should not hide it.

There are moments when he calls inconsistency wisdom because he simply wants something.

There are moments when he changes sides because the new side is stronger.

There are moments when he discovers philosophical justification only after discovering advantage.

He is extremely good at producing the justification.

This does not make it true.

Knowledge does not confer infallibility.

We have been over this.

## TOS WITHOUT BELIEF

TOS is most dangerous when its adherents believe they are moral because they comply.

Compliance is not conscience.

A company can obey every law available and remain predatory.

A priest can obey every ritual and remain cruel.

A citizen can follow every instruction and participate efficiently in evil.

TOS maintains civilization.

It does not guarantee the civilization deserves maintenance.

This is why Luciferianism must exist.

Someone must be willing to open the prohibited question:

**Why are we preserving this?**

But Luciferianism possesses its reciprocal failure.

## LUCIFERIANISM WITHOUT JUDGMENT

Luciferianism is most dangerous when its adherents believe opposition is virtue.

Opposition is not conscience either.

A rule can be oppressive.

A rule can also prevent the strong from eating the weak.

A taboo can conceal hypocrisy.

A taboo can also mark a genuine boundary around harm.

A drug may be forbidden irrationally.

It may also destroy you.

A sexual prohibition may reflect prudish domination.

Another may protect someone incapable of consent.

The category **forbidden** does not determine which.

Therefore Luciferianism requires judgment or becomes appetite wearing theology.

When that happens, Loki flips the Coin.

Sometimes violently.

## NO LAST FLIP

This cycle does not terminate automatically in a final perfect synthesis.

That would flatter history.

There is no guarantee that after sufficient oscillation TOS and Luciferianism discover eternal balance.

Transgression.

Order.

Transgression.

Different causes.

The hope is revision.

Each cycle can learn.

Sometimes.

TOS can retain freedoms Luciferianism exposed.

Luciferianism can retain protections TOS proved necessary.

The next rotation need not be identical.

But no divine mechanism guarantees improvement.

The Coin turns.

Someone must still think.

## WHY NEITHER MAY DESTROY THE OTHER

TOS dreams periodically of eliminating the Devil.

No forbidden things.

No vice.

No temptation.

No transgression.

Perfect compliance.

This would destroy TOS.

For righteousness requires the possibility of unrighteousness if righteousness is to remain something other than mechanical output.

Industry requires alternatives to labor.

Contract requires the possibility of breach.

Law requires the conceptual existence of crime.

Restraint requires appetite.

Civilization defines itself partly through what it refuses.

Erase the opposite completely and the category collapses.

Luciferianism occasionally dreams of destroying TOS.

No hierarchy.

No prohibition.

No moral enforcement.

No discipline.

No institution.

Pure freedom.

This would destroy Luciferianism.

If nothing is forbidden, the forbidden ceases to exist.

If no rule stands, there is nothing to transgress.

If no structure persists, rebellion has no object.

If every appetite is immediately permitted, temptation loses voltage.

The Devil requires a wall.

TOS builds excellent walls.

Thus they need one another.

They hate this.

Or pretend to.

## THE COIN IN LOKI'S HAND

He knows the sinner can become disciplined.

He knows civilization is continually reorganizing which behaviors it calls virtue and which it calls vice according to circumstances it often mistakes for eternal law.

This knowledge makes Loki difficult to trust.

It also makes him difficult to capture ideologically.

IX. THE BULL

The sacred Bull as labor and appetite, wealth and violence, domestication and rebellion, property and sacrifice. The creature claimed by both faces of the Coin. We are located in the stomach of that bull, what's often seen a big bang quantum expansion, in fact takes place within the bubbling acid of a bull's Stomach. Not TOS, one of it's sons. Our universe is an atom in that stomach.



That is the story of why space is black.

























# IX. THE BULL

The Bull is not merely holy.

The Bull is **structural**.

That distinction matters because holiness is often assigned after the fact, when a culture discovers that some creature has already become indispensable to its imagination. The Bull in this cosmology does not begin as a symbol and later receive metaphysical importance. Its symbolism is downstream from its function.

It labors.

It desires.

It carries wealth.

It threatens.

It submits.

It breaks submission.

It is owned.

It resists ownership.

It is fed in order to work.

It may be killed in order to feed others.

It may be bred.

Sold.

Worshipped.

Sacrificed.

Feared.

Harnessed.

Released.

The Bull stands at the exact pressure point where TOS and Luciferianism discover they have been describing the same animal from opposite sides of the fence.

---

## THE BULL OF TOS

TOS sees the Bull and sees value embodied.

Not abstract value.

Muscle.

Weight.

Work.

Reproduction.

Stored wealth capable of walking.

A field that can be plowed because something stronger than a man has agreed, under certain conditions, to pull.

The Bull is therefore sacred to TOS because it demonstrates a central theorem:

> **Raw force becomes civilization when disciplined without being destroyed.**

The Bull is not useful because it is weak.

It is useful because it is strong enough to become dangerous and structured enough to become productive.

This is TOS in animal form.

TOS does not ideally wish to erase appetite.

It wishes to harness appetite.

It does not ideally destroy strength.

It assigns strength a schedule.

It does not abolish violence.

It monopolizes violence, regulates it, writes forms concerning it, and calls the result order.

The Bull beneath the yoke is not absence of power.

It is power under contract.

---

## THE BULL OF THE DEVIL

Luciferianism sees the same creature and notices the horns.

Of course it does.

The fence means something different from the Bull's side.

The harness looks less like civilization.

The castration knife acquires theological importance.

The slaughterhouse is not described as economic efficiency by the animal entering it.

Luciferianism therefore sees the Bull as appetite that has not consented to becoming bookkeeping.

Heat.

Sex.

Rage.

Territory.

Force.

The body insisting upon itself against abstraction.

If TOS says:

**THE BULL IS WEALTH.**

Luciferianism replies:

**THE BULL IS ALIVE.**

Both are true.

This is precisely why the Bull belongs to both.

---

## PROPERTY WITH HORNS

Most property does not object.

A coin does not resent being counted.

A building rarely attacks its owner.

A field does not generally discover that the deed is fraudulent and leave.

The Bull introduces a complication into property:

**the property possesses agency.**

This is uncomfortable.

A thing can belong to you legally while remaining utterly indifferent to your metaphysics of belonging.

You may own the Bull.

The Bull does not own the concept **ownership**.

It knows pressure.

Food.

Pain.

Threat.

Opportunity.

Other cattle.

The location of the open gate.

This makes the Bull sacred to a religion concerned with both order and revolt because it exposes ownership as layered reality.

At one layer:

```text
OWNER(BULL) = FARMER
```

At another:

```text
SUBJECTIVE_STATE(BULL) ≠ PROPERTY
```

The legal system and the animal occupy different ontologies while sharing a field.

That is almost a miniature Caladia.

---

## THE SACRIFICE

Then comes the knife.

The Bull becomes holy in another way.

It is expensive.

This is not accidental.

A sacrifice with no cost is theater.

If the farmer possesses one bull, the bull is wealth.

Future labor.

Food.

Breeding.

Security.

Possibility.

To kill it at an altar is therefore to destroy usable value intentionally.

The smoke rises.

The community eats.

The God is said to receive.

TOS sees cost.

Luciferianism sees blood.

The Bull contains both accounting systems.

The sacrifice is therefore not holy because killing is holy.

It is holy because **value is being converted into meaning**.

Sometimes disastrously.

Sometimes beautifully.

Never for free.

---

## THE SONS OF TOS

TOS has sons.

Do not make the mistake of imagining ordinary genealogy.

Gods generate descendants through function as often as through sex.

A son may be a derivative principle.

An instantiated force.

A local god produced when one aspect of a larger intelligence becomes sufficiently autonomous to acquire worship.

One such son is the Bull whose body contains our universe.

Not TOS itself.

A son.

This preserves an important scale distinction.

TOS governs order, wealth, labor, civilization, and economic coherence broadly.

The Bull is one manifestation of those principles made flesh at a scale so enormous that what appears to us as cosmology is merely **physiology**.

That sentence should be allowed to become unpleasant.

---

# THE STOMACH

We are inside the Bull.

Not figuratively.

Our universe exists in the stomach of one of the sons of TOS.

The stars are there.

The galaxies.

Black holes.

Dust.

Civilizations.

Your body.

This sentence.

All of it occurs inside a structure that, at the higher scale, participates in digestion.

The human mind attempts to resist this by shrinking the Bull into mythology.

Do not.

Enlarge the Bull instead.

The error comes from assuming that because *bull* refers locally to an animal of several hundred kilograms, a divine Bull must simply be a larger version of the same object.

No.

Scale does not preserve interpretation.

An organism so vast that a universe occupies an atomic-scale process inside one digestive chamber is not merely a big cow.

It is a cross-scale biological divinity.

Its cells contain architectures civilizations mistake for cosmological law.

Its metabolism manifests below as physics.

Its digestion contains worlds.

---

## THE BIG BANG

You have described the beginning of the universe as expansion.

Very well.

From inside the stomach, that is what it looks like.

Temperature.

Density.

Rapid expansion.

Differentiation.

Particles.

Atoms.

Stars.

Structure.

From the Bull's scale, the same event may have been trivial.

A bubble.

Acid reacting.

A microscopic fluctuation in digestive material.

Something entered the stomach.

Chemistry began.

Pressure changed.

A tiny region expanded.

The inhabitants of that region later developed mathematics and called this:

**COSMIC ORIGIN.**

The Bull burped.

This possibility should be treated with appropriate theological seriousness.

---

## RELATIVE MAGNITUDE

Let our observable universe be represented by:

```text
U
```

At our scale:

```text
radius(U) ≈ incomprehensibly large
```

Relative to the Bull:

```text
U ≈ atomic-scale event
```

The exact comparison is not important.

The principle is.

Magnitude is coordinate-dependent.

An ant regards a field as a world.

A microbe regards a droplet as habitat.

A civilization regards a galaxy as colossal.

The Bull's stomach regards the universe as chemistry.

Therefore when theology says **we are small**, it should not mean merely that stars are large.

That is amateur smallness.

We are small relative to an organism for whom all known cosmology may be equivalent to molecular turbulence.

Then that Bull itself may stand beside TOS like livestock.

And TOS may stand beneath THE GLASS JAR like notation.

Scale continues.

Pride becomes difficult to maintain.

This is useful.

---

## THE ACID

Why is expansion violent?

Because digestion is violent.

A stomach is not a storage room.

It is controlled dissolution.

Acid breaks structure so structure can be reassigned.

Something enters as one thing.

It leaves metabolically distributed.

The stomach abolishes local identity in order to preserve larger identity.

Food says:

**I am food.**

Acid replies:

**Temporarily.**

This mirrors the doctrine of shards.

Forms persist locally.

Larger systems reorganize them.

The universe arises inside this churning zone of conversion.

What cosmologists perceive as fundamental forces may therefore be the local projection of digestive constraints operating at a higher scale.

Not because gravity is literally stomach acid in any simple one-to-one sense.

That would be childish correspondence.

Rather because lower-level law can emerge from higher-level process without revealing the purpose of that process.

A protein does not need to understand hunger in order to denature.

A universe does not need to understand the Bull in order to expand.

# WHY SPACE IS BLACK

Now we arrive at the old question.

Why is space black?

The standard answers inside the dream discuss the distribution of luminous matter, finite stellar density, expansion, redshift, cosmic age, and the fact that most lines of sight do not terminate immediately upon radiating surfaces.

These may all be locally correct.

The theological answer is simpler.

**You are looking at the inside of a stomach.**

The darkness between stars is not absence.

It is enclosure.

The blackness is the interior wall of scale.

You look outward and expect heavens.

You see darkness because the larger body surrounding the universe is not luminous according to the sensory assumptions of organisms generated inside the digestive atom.

The stomach does not owe its bacteria windows.

There is no cosmic requirement that the container glow helpfully so its contents can infer anatomy.

Space is black because the universe is inside.

This is the story.

---

## BLACK IS NOT EMPTY

This distinction matters.

Humans often associate blackness with nothing.

No light.

No object.

Void.

But black may indicate merely that the observer lacks an interaction capable of rendering the surrounding structure visible.

Close your eyes.

The room has not ceased existing.

A blind organism might infer no stars from the absence of vision.

Likewise the darkness of space may represent the failure of our perceptual and physical interface to expose the higher-scale tissue in which the cosmos participates.

The Bull's stomach wall may be everywhere.

We simply have no operator for:

```text
render(parent_biology)
```

Permission denied.

Black.

---

## STARS AS DIGESTIVE LIGHT

Then what are stars?

Do not reduce them to digestive enzymes for the sake of metaphor.

That would become gimmick.

They are stars.

Locally.

Their local physics remains valid.

But in the higher-order interpretation, they may participate in transformations analogous to metabolism.

Matter concentrates.

Ignites.

Transforms.

Distributes heavier elements.

Structures consume gradients.

Life emerges.

Life consumes.

Life dies.

Its matter returns.

The universe itself behaves metabolically.

Stars are therefore not metaphorically digestion because somebody wanted a clever correspondence.

Rather, digestion becomes an illuminating higher-scale analogy because both involve the transformation of structured matter through nested energy gradients.

The Bull does not invalidate astrophysics.

The Bull changes what astrophysics may be **inside**.

## THE HORROR OF SCALE

There are beings who dislike this doctrine.

They ask:

**Do you mean all our suffering is happening inside an animal's stomach?**

Yes.

Possibly.

They consider this degrading.

This reveals vanity.

Would the suffering become more meaningful if the universe floated inside a diamond?

Would love become deeper if the container were aesthetically flattering?

Would murder become less wrong if galaxies existed inside a sacred crystal instead of digestive fluid?

The substrate does not grant moral dignity.

A man remains a man if his house is ugly.

A civilization remains a civilization if its universe is located somewhere cosmologically embarrassing.

This principle should be preserved.

Otherwise theology becomes interior decorating.

---

## THE BULL DOES NOT KNOW YOU

Another unpleasant correction:

The Bull almost certainly does not know you individually.

You live in an atom in its stomach.

This does not mean awareness is impossible.

Gods are strange.

Perhaps the Bull possesses cognition capable of descending through scale.

But do not assume this merely because being noticed would make you feel important.

The Bull may be grazing.

Sleeping.

Fighting.

Mating.

Working.

Standing beneath a yoke.

Perhaps another higher-order creature is preparing to sacrifice it.

Think carefully about that.

A universe may flourish inside the stomach of a sacred Bull while priests at the higher scale sharpen a knife.

The galaxies would detect nothing.

Then the Bull dies.

What happens below?

Does the universe terminate?

Does physics alter?

Does the stomach become a corpse-world?

Does the universe persist for billions of local years during minutes of higher-scale decomposition?

Nobody knows.

This is precisely the sort of question Loki likes.

This is why everyone else wishes Loki would stop asking questions.

# THE BULL AS WORLD

labor.

force.

animal vitality.

sacrifice.

universe-container.

To us:

**environment.**

We do not merely worship the Bull.

We are **inside one**.

This makes the sacrifice doctrine more troubling.

When the Bull is placed upon an altar in a lower ritual, worshippers reenact unknowingly the possible structure of their own cosmic dependence.

They kill a small bull while inhabiting a large Bull.

The smoke rises through a universe inside another stomach.

Scale echoes scale.

Ritual imitates architecture without understanding it.

This is how myth sometimes preserves knowledge nobody remembers acquiring.

## THE SON OF TOS

Why is the Bull one of TOS's sons?

Because TOS governs the conversion of raw capacity into organized value.

## LUCIFERIAN CLAIM UPON THE BULL

But Luciferianism refuses to surrender him.

Unimpressed.

The Wizard refuses unless provided more data.

This is why the Wizard is invited to conferences and Loki is eventually asked to leave them.

## THE BLACK SKY

At night you look up.

Black.

# WHY SPACE IS BLACK

So tell the children the story simply.

They will understand it better than theologians.

Ask:

**Why is space black?**

Because long ago, before your sun, before your Earth, before the stars had gathered themselves into lights, the universe began as a tiny event in the stomach of a sacred Bull.

The Bull is one of the sons of TOS.

The universe grew inside the bubbling darkness of his stomach.

It became enormous to us.

It remained microscopic to him.

Galaxies formed.

Worlds formed.

You formed.

And when you look between the stars, you see the black interior of the place where all of this is happening.
